description: The sequence of side-lengths that occur when drawing a sequence of squares in the plane with integer side lengths such that the bottom-left corner of the k-th square is at the nonnegative integer point (k, y_k), subject to the conditions that (1) the interior of each square has a distinct pattern made by the perimeters of the other squares, and (2) the sequence (a(0), y_0, a(1), y_1, a(2), y_2, ...) is the lexicographically earliest such infinite sequence.
